title: Animated Tabs Bar
subtitle: Switch between views; the highlight glides to the active tab.

descriptions.activeIndicator: How the active tab is marked: a pill or underline that glides to it, or an underline that fades in.
descriptions.activeColor: Colour of the gliding pill. Only used by Glide pill.
descriptions.hoverHighlight: Highlights the tab under the pointer.
descriptions.divider: Draws a line under the row of tabs.
descriptions.listBorder: Draws a border around the row of tabs.
descriptions.panelBorder: Draws a border around the tab content.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the tabs, the pill and the borders.
descriptions.contentAnimation: How content changes when you switch tabs.
descriptions.slideDistance: How far content slides when switching tabs, in pixels. Needs Content animation set to Slide.
descriptions.smoothHeight: The content area animates to each tab's height instead of jumping.
descriptions.fadeDuration: How long the fade takes, in seconds. Needs Content animation set to Fade in / out.
descriptions.duration: How long the indicator and content take to move, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: Springiness of the indicator and slide. Does nothing with Fade underline unless Content animation is Slide.

patches: "flex min-h-[60vh] flex-col justify-start rounded-lg border px-[4vw] py-8"
"flex min-h-120 max-md:min-h-96 flex-col justify-start px-12 py-8 max-lg:px-8 max-md:px-0"
// With reduced motion on, every move lands instantly.
themeDescription: Colour palette. The Primary pill and the underlines use its primary colour; any theme but Default also tints the active tab's text with the underline styles.
modeDescription: Light or dark version of the palette.
